SELECT DISTINCT idcase FROM ( SELECT idcase, activity, resource, timestamp, LEAD(activity) OVER (PARTITION BY idcase ORDER BY timestamp, id) AS next_activity, LEAD(resource) OVER (PARTITION BY idcase ORDER BY timestamp, id) AS next_resource FROM event_log ) WHERE activity = next_activity AND resource != next_resource ORDER BY idcase

SELECT e.idcase, COUNT(*) as events_before FROM event_log e WHERE e.idcase IN ( SELECT DISTINCT idcase FROM event_log WHERE activity = 'Declaration final approved by director' ) AND e.timestamp < ( SELECT MIN(timestamp) FROM event_log e2 WHERE e2.idcase = e.idcase AND e2.activity = 'Declaration final approved by director' ) GROUP BY e.idcase ORDER BY e.idcase

SELECT e1.idcase, ROUND((JULIANDAY(e2.timestamp) - JULIANDAY(e1.timestamp)) * 24 * 60, 2) AS time_difference_minutes FROM event_log e1 JOIN event_log e2 ON e1.idcase = e2.idcase WHERE e1.activity = 'Permit submitted by employee' AND e2.activity = 'Permit approved by administration' AND e2.timestamp > e1.timestamp ORDER BY e1.idcase

WITH ordered_events AS ( SELECT idcase, activity, timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY idcase ORDER BY timestamp, id) as rn FROM event_log ), consecutive_check AS ( SELECT e1.idcase, e1.activity as activity1, e2.activity as activity2 FROM ordered_events e1 JOIN ordered_events e2 ON e1.idcase = e2.idcase AND e2.rn = e1.rn + 1 WHERE e1.activity = 'Send reminder' AND e2.activity = 'Send reminder' ) SELECT DISTINCT idcase FROM consecutive_check ORDER BY idcase
